gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-work-sans: Round, friendly, drafting-pen lines: that's Fuzzy Bubbles, with small letters nearly as tall as its capitals. And if the heading shrinks too far, the plain sans Work Sans takes over the page.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-fs-bespoke-sans: Stretched-out letters that look like bent glass tubing. Hachi Maru Pop brings that relaxed, hand-drawn warmth, while Bespoke Sans, a sharp and refined sans, gives curves generous room beside the stem.
gen-gf-iansui-fs-bespoke-sans: Friendly and hand-drawn, Iansui gives diagonals the full weight of its uprights. And Bespoke Sans, plain sans with generous space at its curve ends, keeps paragraphs sharp and unhurried.
gen-gf-klee-one-fs-literata: Graceful, pen-drawn letters lead in Klee One, terminals cut short. Literata, a bookish serif with sturdy hairlines and slightly heavier stems, carries paragraphs along with a smooth, modest gradient.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-fs-bespoke-sans: Curves that keep real weight even at their thinnest points give Lugrasimo a loose, hand-drawn, friendly line. Shrink the heading, and Bespoke Sans, the plain sans, soon speaks louder.
gen-gf-lumanosimo-fs-literata: Rounded, cord-like strokes drawn out across wide, open gaps give Lumanosimo a loose, casual, graceful look. Literata steadies things, with stems that outweigh the hairlines just a little.
gen-gf-nanum-gothic-coding-fs-bespoke-sa: One marker-like line, bent into letters, makes up Nanum Gothic Coding. Bespoke Sans, the plain sans with generous space around its curve ends, gives that loose line a sharper, refined partner.
gen-gf-nanum-gothic-coding-fs-literata: Marker-plain and wide-mouthed, Nanum Gothic Coding is all relaxed handwriting. Literata, a sophisticated, bookish serif, does the opposite job, with a faint pull between heavy verticals and lighter horizontals.
gen-gf-over-the-rainbow-archivo: Lines like thin steel rod bent into letters, each ending in a shallow curl, give Over the Rainbow its casual hand. Archivo, an editorial sans, stands tall and open beside it.
gen-gf-over-the-rainbow-fs-asap: No calligraphic modulation here: Over the Rainbow bends every letter from thin steel rod, casual and personal. Asap is plain sans with open arcs and near-capital height, so paragraphs stay readable and steady.
